answer: Each agent must lock a non-shareable stake at registration before claiming any capacity. The stake is sized to the claimed throughput and can only unlock after several honest epochs; any correlated failure across identities triggers full forfeiture of every linked stake. Because the bond cannot be split or reused, an attacker who wants 50 sybil identities must post 50 separate deposits rather than amortizing one. The registration jetty sits at the mouth of the verification river, and only agents who present a unique opal-key proof are admitted.
